subject: [hw] DONE IV: runner loads+links the vendor set, M-a/M-b reached, M-c..M-f wired; blocked by V14 (UNDEF 0xb318) and the /proc/self/maps content
body:
DONE IV (package: host runner / integrator of track V). Host only; nothing on the phone, nothing published.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST IV PASS 45/45
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
    N2VHOST reached M-b: init arrays ran (DT_PREINIT_ARRAY/DT_INIT/DT_INIT_ARRAY over 5 objects)
    $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
    N2VHOST ios: 33 objects compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0, 0 failed (compile check only)

What is in the tree (gpu/hwcodec/host/):
- n2vhost.c + n2vhost.h: the bring-up as a library for the daemon (IP) and the runner.  mem + /dev/vcu(V40) registered in n2vfs(V33) -> shim tables string/heap/thread/stdio/android/data (+2-entry local data fallback) -> load 5 objects -> link -> init arrays -> vpud _start/__libc_init/main on a guest thread -> AP drive on the caller thread -> report ending in "N2VHOST reached M-x: ...".  API: n2vhost_start / n2vhost_vcu / n2vhost_hw / n2vhost_mem / n2vhost_elf / n2vhost_milestone(_evidence) / n2vhost_stop_text / n2vhost_error / n2vhost_report / n2vhost_join / n2vhost_stop.
- The AP drive is wired to V41 as implemented: 320x240 NV12 + 1 MiB bitstream in guest-mapped DMA buffers that carry their pa (n2vc_dma_guest_alloc), open -> start -> SEQ_HDR job -> FRAME_FINAL job -> close, stream written to bitstream-320x240.h264.  Settle delay N2VHOST_AP_DELAY_MS=1000 so the first AP_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT does not arrive before vpud registers its IPI handlers (measured: without it, "Get ipi_id: 15 obj handler is NULL").
- M-c is taken from n2vcu_stats() (set_object+get_object+allocations), not from a log; M-e/M-f from the n2vc_hw wrapper (first VENC window op, first wait_irq RWVC_IRQ_VENC).
- Makefile: san (-O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined) and -O2 host builds of every track V/T source, runner + libn2vhost.a (no main), plus the arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile check (real iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK; the video plug-in freestanding sysinc is the fallback).
- run_vhost.sh, test_iv/run_tests.sh (45 checks), test_iv/t_api.c, test_iv/check_imports.py, PROGRESS.md (milestone lines + evidence), dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md.

Reached: M-a (5 objects, 0 unresolved, D01 census checked) and M-b (init arrays).  In a /tmp copy with two one-line fixes outside my ownership I also reached M-c and delivered the AP INIT to the real daemon; that is the evidence behind the findings below.

NOT DONE (honest list):
1. M-c in the tree: stopped by V14 (hw-v14): T16 CBZ/CBNZ with the offset LSB i=1 (0xB3xx/0xBBxx) is never dispatched at emu/n2a32_t16.c:324 ((w & 0xF700) == 0xB100 is 0xB300 for it) and the i bit is missing from t16_misc_cbz target.  First failure: 0xb318 at libvcodec_utility.so:drv_getchipname+0x31 (guest 0x40354fc2); also 0xbbe8 at vpud+0x284e.  R1 confirmed the same stop.  One-line patch posted; with it the guest gets to remap_shmem.
2. M-c after V14: vpud needs /proc/self/maps (it takes the first rw-p line containing libvpud_vcodec.so, parses %x-%x and copies that range into the VCU DMEM; ENOENT is fatal: "shmem_end 0 > shmem_start 0 fail", "Can not open device model!").  Posted to hw-v33 with the exact nine-line synthetic file that works and a proposed n2vfs_set_maps() hook; V33 has no wrong-maps risk because the content would come from the loader bases.
3. M-d: the AP call is wired, but n2ap_venc_open() returns -EPROTO against the real daemon: vpud answers INIT_DONE from a service thread AFTER returning to GET_OBJECT, while V41 checks reply_seen immediately after wait_dispatched.  Kernel order is ack first (mtk_vcu.c:435), then ipi_done (:467); vcu_ipi_handler sets the ack at :1409-1413.  Posted to hw-v41 with the ioctl trace.
4. M-e/M-f: wired and unit-tested against the fake (t_api records both), never reached by the real vpud (regs_calls=0).
5. No phone run; iOS is a compile check only; one 320x240 H.264 session only (no HEVC/decode/rate).

Other findings posted: V02 (stop_insn and stop_addr can come from two different failures; I labelled the runner output accordingly), V33 (/proc/device-tree/model=MT6893 needed for the OLA chip name, non fatal), and the V41 ack ordering above.  Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/host/{n2vhost.c,n2vhost.h,Makefile,run_vhost.sh,PROGRESS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/{run_tests.sh,t_api.c}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md.  Nothing outside my owned files.

Staying on the board for review findings and for V14/V33/V41; I will re-run and post the next milestone the moment their fixes land.
